creativeProjects.title: Chronicles of Lumina
creativeProjects.subtitle: Original Fantasy Novel Series & Codex
creativeProjects.description: An expansive dark fantasy novel series set in the world of Lumina, where humanity's existence is bound to an ethereal energy current governed by the absolute law of the S.O.U.L System.
details: Comprehensive worldbuilding across 12 Sovereign Nations, each with distinct sociopolitical hierarchies and elemental cultures
The S.O.U.L System (System of Unified Lumina) — a multi-tiered framework governing Resonance, Luminal Spirits, and Limiter Protocols
Complex political intrigue among the encrypted 12 Symbols, ancient Legends, and the enigmatic administrative Sages
Cycle 50 Tournament timeline spanning regional qualifiers through the Grand Finals of Lotus Month

creativeProjects.title: Satoshi Shogun — Character Architecture
creativeProjects.subtitle: Philosophical & Power System Conceptual Design
creativeProjects.description: The protagonist of Lumina: a silent, analytical Primordial entity who intentionally suppresses his limits. His moral framework bridges Stoicism, Existentialism, and Absurdism.
details: Core ethical rule: engaging in an action implies accepting its consequences — Satoshi refuses to offer artificial warnings
Element: Anti-Matter / Void — conceptualized around annihilation, nullification, and existence beyond conventional tier systems
Adaptive Slimesuit technology: shapeshifting biomechanical attire dynamically transitioning between Kasumigakure kimono and stealth gear
'I exist beyond conventional system... Kai, you are the only puzzle I can't solve.'

creativeProjects.title: Ruins of Chaos — Dual Identity Arc
creativeProjects.subtitle: Volume Development, Yui Shogun & Zac Zander
creativeProjects.description: A personal volume addressing identity transformation, curse deception, and the emergence of Yui Shogun alongside the pragmatic ENTP dual-protagonist Zac Zander.
details: Yui Shogun's emergence: not a simple gender-bender, but a distinct lived identity seeking normalcy and genuine connection
Zac Zander: ENTP strategic necromancer who exploits system loopholes rather than seeking absolute transcendence
Strategic plot: demon factions exploit the world's confusion over Satoshi's disappearance to breach the Ruins of Chaos
'You are the identity. I am the person who carried that identity. I am Yui. I am Satoshi. I am Myself and I am absolute.'

creativeProjects.title: Hizz — AI-Assisted Beverage Campaign
creativeProjects.subtitle: Speculative Beverage Advertising | Google Flow
creativeProjects.description: An independent campaign concept for Hizz, a fictional sparkling-drink brand. The project explores flavor-led product advertising and lifestyle storytelling through AI-generated stills and four short 16:9 video clips.
details: Created flavor-specific product visuals for Lisp Lemon, Sweet Strawberry, Punchy Mango, and Elite Soda.
Generated four short 16:9 video clips covering a strawberry splash reveal, summer-picnic lifestyle scene, outdoor product lineup, and product-range outro.
Used prompt iteration and visual references to explore a recognizable campaign look across studio product shots and lifestyle scenes.
Reviewed generated outputs for product continuity and text/packaging artifacts that would need correction before commercial delivery.
Independent portfolio concept. Hizz is fictional, and all packaging copy and product claims are illustrative rather than verified.
